summary: The legal number has at most ten decimal digits, so every allowed k yields at most 100 total digit-character inspections and cannot support an honest asymptotic runtime trend.

workload_bound.source_constraint: 1 <= num <= 10^9 gives d <= 10, while 1 <= k <= d and at most d-k+1 windows are parsed

replacement_checks.evidence: At most d-k+1 windows are examined and each contains k digits, so (d-k+1)k <= d^2 <= 100.
Authored cases cover one and ten digits, k equal to one and d, zero windows, leading zeroes, repeated qualifying values, no qualifying value, and the numeric upper bound.
